checks.description: SKILL.md has valid name and description frontmatter
work-unit registry has unique semantic ids without numeric stage prefixes
standard, rework, and escalation transitions reference registered units
start and completion artifacts are producible and belong to their units
field-specific rules are isolated in lazy project profiles
reading-session anchors are enabled by repository policy rather than imposed globally
new router does not require old numbered workflow entry
language references protect numbers, formulas, citations and stance
runtime exposes guarded commands for decisions, gates, completion, and handoff
registry defines gate evidence, block transitions, prerequisites, outputs, and write scopes
every work unit has executable stage-specific quality checks bound to reachable required gates
material changes map to valid affected units and gates, mark completed outputs stale, and resolve only after re-audit
bypass attempts fail and valid BLOCK-to-PASS recovery succeeds in an isolated res directory
capability, lookup, optional-journal, template-package, editor-letter, and freshness contracts pass positive and negative runtime paths
positive and negative fixtures verify an executable source-to-evidence-to-claim-to-synthesis-to-paragraph-to-revision chain
uncertain claims create a human checkpoint instead of being silently completed
review type and eligibility are recorded before broad retrieval
